_comment: A race class and a durability class, three rounds each, both at the same write primitive. One trailer naming only the primitive must not clear both — it has to name the invariant it fixed.

findings.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Revalidate the session after the await**

The row is read before the await and `writeSessionMessage` runs after it, so a concurrent archive wins the race and nothing revalidates the row in between.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Roll back the stamp when the write throws**

The stamp is persisted before `writeSessionMessage` runs and never rolled back when it throws, so a failed write leaves the stamp behind and the next caller overwrites it.
